title_en: The Girl Lay Down and Fell Asleep
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The last lines of stanzas 3 to 5 ('како него да се тркала', 'низ него да се провира', 'со него да се ќердосам') are my reading as the girl's wish: to roll like the apple, to slip through the ring, to enjoy herself with the kisser. 'ќердосам' is a dialect word I am unsure of.

lines.en: The girl lay down and fell asleep

lines.cyr: на мајкино си колено аман, ѓули аман,
lines.lat: na majkino si koleno aman, ǵuli aman,
lines.en: on her mother's knee, aman, gül, aman,
just as the girl fell asleep,

lines.cyr: големо соне видело аман, ѓули аман.
lines.lat: golemo sone videlo aman, ǵuli aman.
lines.en: she saw a great dream, aman, gül, aman.
In the dream came three lads,

lines.cyr: три луди млади беќари аман, ѓули аман.
lines.lat: tri ludi mladi beḱari aman, ǵuli aman.
lines.en: three young bachelors, aman, gül, aman.
The first one who passed by me,

lines.cyr: тој ми потфрли јаболко аман, ѓули аман,
lines.lat: toj mi potfrli jabolko aman, ǵuli aman,
lines.en: he threw an apple to me, aman, gül, aman,
the one who threw the apple,

lines.cyr: како него да се тркала аман, ѓули аман.
lines.lat: kako nego da se trkala aman, ǵuli aman.
lines.en: I would roll after him like it, aman, gül, aman.
The second one who passed by me,

lines.cyr: тој ми потфрли злат прстен аман, ѓули аман,
lines.lat: toj mi potfrli zlat prsten aman, ǵuli aman,
lines.en: he threw a gold ring to me, aman, gül, aman,
the one who threw the gold ring,

lines.cyr: низ него да се провира аман, ѓули аман.
lines.lat: niz nego da se provira aman, ǵuli aman.
lines.en: I would slip through him like it, aman, gül, aman.
The third one who passed by me,

lines.cyr: тој мене на сон целува аман, ѓули аман,
lines.lat: toj mene na son celuva aman, ǵuli aman,
lines.en: he kisses me in the dream, aman, gül, aman,

lines.cyr: тој што мене на сон целува
lines.lat: toj što mene na son celuva
lines.en: the one who kisses me in the dream,

lines.cyr: со него да се ќердосам аман, ѓули аман.
lines.lat: so nego da se ḱerdosam aman, ǵuli aman.
lines.en: I would enjoy myself with him, aman, gül, aman.
